Here’s a draft you can drop into flyers and emails:

Join us for an outdoor Composting Workshop at the Community Garden in Madison. We’ll cover composting basics—what can and can’t go in your pile, how to balance “greens” and “browns,” how to manage moisture and airflow, and simple ways to use finished compost in your yard or garden.

This workshop is designed for neighbors and beginners. If you’re curious about starting a compost bin at home or in your community garden plot, this session will give you clear, practical steps to get started.

Because this is an outdoor event in December, please:
- Dress warmly in layers, including a hat and gloves.
- Wear sturdy, closed-toe shoes or boots that can handle cold and possibly muddy ground.
- Consider bringing a warm drink in a thermos.
- Optional: bring a small notebook and pen for tips and recipes for good compost “mixes.”

We’ll keep the session hands-on, down-to-earth, and focused on what works in our local climate and backyards.</action>
